fractal.title: The Fractal Pizza Palace
fractal.subtitle: Where every slice hides a whole pizza inside

slice.title: The magic pizza
slice.intro: 🍕 **Welcome to the Pizza Palace!** The chef bakes one very strange pizza: every time you slice it, EVERY triangle turns into 3 smaller pizzas — and the middle disappears! Press **Slice!** a few times and watch what happens. Tap the pieces too — see how tiny they get!
slice.tapHint: Press Slice! and watch every triangle follow the same rule…
slice.sliced: Every triangle became 3 smaller pizzas — the same rule, again and again!
slice.done: You found the palace's secret: one simple rule, repeated! 🌟

zoom.title: The infinite zoom
zoom.intro: 🔍 **Look closer…** See the three corner slices glowing? Pick one and zoom into it. Careful — this pizza has a magical surprise waiting inside. Zoom 3 times and see if you can escape!
zoom.pickCorner: Tap a glowing corner slice to zoom into it!
zoom.done: However deep you zoom, the same pizza is waiting. You could zoom in FOREVER — that's called self-similarity! ✨

count.title: The pizza counter
count.intro: 🧮 **The waiter needs help!** Every slicing turns each triangle into 3 little pizzas. So how many pieces after each slice? Count carefully — watch the numbers grow faster and faster!
count.question: We slice every triangle again — how many little pizzas now?
count.retry: Hmm, remember — every single triangle turns into 3…
count.done: 1, 3, 9, 27, 81… each slice makes 3 times as many! Numbers that multiply grow SO fast! 🚀

hunt.title: Fractal hunters
hunt.intro: 🔍 **Fractals escaped the kitchen!** They're hiding all over the world. Look at each thing and ask the magic question: do little copies of the whole thing hide inside it? If yes — it's a fractal!
hunt.retry: Zoom in with your eyes — do you see small copies of the whole thing?
hunt.done: You can spot fractals anywhere now — broccoli, ferns, lightning… nature LOVES repeating rules! 🌿

chef.title: The fractal chef
chef.intro: 👨‍🍳 **Now YOU are the chef!** Invent your own slicing rule: on the recipe card, choose which of the 4 parts keep their pizza. Then press **Bake!** again and again and watch YOUR rule build YOUR fractal!
chef.ruleHint: Tap the recipe card to change your rule, then bake it — again and again!
chef.needTwo: Keep at least 2 parts, or there won't be a pizza left to bake!
chef.fullDepth: Fully baked! Your rule, repeated into a fractal masterpiece! 🎺
chef.done: You repeated your own rule 3 times — you built a real fractal! 👨‍🍳

skills.selfSimilar: The same shape hides inside itself
skills.powersOfThree: Each slicing makes 3 times as many pieces
skills.inNature: I can spot self-similar shapes in the real world
skills.repeatRule: A simple rule, repeated, builds a fractal

fractal.finished: You discovered two great secrets: a simple rule repeated forever builds endless worlds — and the same pattern hides at every size, in pizzas, in broccoli, in lightning. The whole kingdom looks different when you zoom in. 🍕✨
